message.headline: ...SPACE WEATHER WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT FOR ONGOING AND RENEWED MAJOR GEOMAGNETIC STORM THROUGH 1800 UTC SUN MAY 12...
message.what: Warning-level geomagnetic storming is ongoing. Another series of coronal mass ejections is expected to produce renewed G3-G5 activity.
message.where: Worldwide and Earth's orbit. Higher-latitude regions and locations with enhanced geoelectric susceptibility face the greatest potential effects.
message.observed: G5 conditions have occurred, and geomagnetic storming remains in progress at 1230 UTC Sat May 11 2024.
message.changed: There is an 80% chance of renewed coronal mass ejection impact between 0600 UTC Sun May 12 2024 and 1800 UTC Sun May 12 2024. Earliest Renewed Impact: 0600 UTC Sun May 12 2024 Most Likely Renewed Impact: 1200 UTC Sun May 12 2024 Latest Renewed Impact: 1800 UTC Sun May 12 2024
message.duration: Minimum Duration After Impact: 12 hours Latest Expected End: Beyond 0000 UTC Mon May 13 2024
message.unchanged: The existing Warning remains in effect, and partners should maintain heightened operations.
message.confidence: There is a 60% chance that disturbed conditions will last at least 12 hours after renewed impact and a 15% chance that warning-level conditions will continue beyond 0000 UTC Mon May 13 2024. Exact storm strength and duration remain uncertain.
message.impacts: Power systems may experience voltage-control issues, transformer stress, and isolated equipment trips. Atmospheric drag may lower satellite orbits and reduce tracking and orbit-prediction accuracy. HF communication, precision satellite navigation, and some satellite communications may be intermittently degraded, particularly at higher latitudes. Geomagnetically induced currents may affect pipeline monitoring and corrosion-control systems. Aurora may be visible much farther south than usual where darkness and local viewing conditions allow.
message.precautionary_preparedness_actions: Partners should continue heightened operations, follow sector-specific procedures, and monitor SWPC updates and decision-support guidance through 0030 UTC Sun May 12 2024.
message.additional_details: This update continues the existing Space Weather Warning. If conditions decrease below warning-level concern, future messaging may transition to a Space Weather Statement.
message.next_update: No later than 0030 UTC Sun May 12 2024, or sooner if conditions change.
